title: Receipt-clock callback failure is recoverable and can extend stale authority
description: python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py::_receipt_now permanently disables the receipt clock and clears receipts only for regression/reentry. If the bound MonotonicClock callback raises or returns an invalid value, the exception escapes without setting _receipt_clock_failed or revoking _verified_receipts/_authenticated_dio_issuances. After an arbitrarily long outage the callback may return a barely advanced value, allowing an actually stale one-use receipt or DIO issuance to remain usable; Node's receive loop catches non-LinkSecurityClockError exceptions and continues. Treat any callback/capability/validation failure as terminal LinkSecurityClockError, revoke all time-bound authorities, and regress raise/NaN/awaitable then recovery attempts.
